2026-11-01.title: Qudos Eetho Sunday · Sanctification of the Church
readings: The glory of the Lord and the Temple
Christ the cornerstone; a dwelling place for God
On this rock I will build my Church
2026-11-01.verse: And I tell you, you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my church, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.

2026-11-08.title: Hudos Eetho Sunday · Renewal of the Church
readings: My house shall be a house of prayer
Solomon's prayer at the dedication of the Temple
The Lord gathers and renews his people
To the lukewarm Church: I stand at the door and knock
Christ the high priest of the true sanctuary
Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up
2026-11-08.verse: Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.

2026-11-15.title: Sunday of the Message to Zechariah
readings: A son for Abraham and Sarah
Do not fear, I am with you
The message to Zechariah in the Temple
2026-11-15.verse: Do not be afraid, Zechariah, for your prayer has been heard. Your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you will name him John.

2026-11-22.title: Sunday of the Annunciation to Mary, Mother of God
readings: The first promise: the woman and her offspring
Not by might, but by my Spirit
O that you would tear open the heavens and come down
We are called children of God
God sent his Son, born of a woman
The angel Gabriel is sent to Mary
2026-11-22.verse: Here am I, the servant of the Lord; let it be with me according to your word.

2026-11-29.title: Sunday of the Visitation of Mary, Mother of God, to Elizabeth
readings: The deaf shall hear, the blind shall see
God desires everyone to be saved
2026-11-29.verse: And blessed is she who believed that there would be a fulfillment of what was spoken to her by the Lord.

2026-11-02.title: Monday after Qudos Eetho Sunday
2026-11-02.verse: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.

2026-11-03.title: Tuesday after Qudos Eetho Sunday · The 318 Fathers of Nicaea
2026-11-03.verse: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.

2026-11-04.title: Wednesday after Qudos Eetho Sunday
readings: What do you have that you did not receive?
2026-11-04.verse: Do not judge, and you will not be judged; do not condemn, and you will not be condemned. Forgive, and you will be forgiven;

2026-11-05.title: Thursday after Qudos Eetho Sunday
readings: The Lord disciplines those he loves
The Son does what he sees the Father doing
2026-11-05.verse: Now, discipline always seems painful rather than pleasant at the time, but later it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.

2026-11-06.title: Friday after Qudos Eetho Sunday
2026-11-06.verse: Therefore, I tell you, her sins, which were many, have been forgiven; hence she has shown great love.

2026-11-07.title: Saturday after Qudos Eetho Sunday · The 33 Martyrs of Melitene
readings: Sir, we wish to see Jesus
2026-11-07.verse: They came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida in Galilee, and said to him, “Sir, we wish to see Jesus.”

2026-11-09.title: Monday after Hudos Eetho Sunday · St Theodore
readings: A sabbath rest remains for the people of God
Not one of these little ones should be lost
2026-11-09.verse: So it is not the will of your Father in heaven that one of these little ones should be lost.

2026-11-10.title: Tuesday after Hudos Eetho Sunday · The Prophet Samuel; St Leo the Great
2026-11-10.verse: So the last will be first, and the first will be last.

2026-11-11.title: Wednesday after Hudos Eetho Sunday
2026-11-11.verse: For he is our peace; in his flesh he has made both groups into one and has broken down the dividing wall, that is, the hostility between us.

2026-11-12.title: Thursday after Hudos Eetho Sunday · St John the Almsgiver
readings: The eyes of your heart enlightened
2026-11-12.verse: The kingdom of God is as if someone would scatter seed on the ground, and would sleep and rise night and day, and the seed would sprout and grow, he does not know how.

2026-11-13.title: Friday after Hudos Eetho Sunday · St John Chrysostom
readings: God's wisdom revealed through the Spirit
The treasure, the pearl and the net
2026-11-13.verse: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant in search of fine pearls; on finding one pearl of great value, he went and sold all that he had and bought it.

2026-11-14.title: Saturday after Hudos Eetho Sunday · Mar Philipose Shleeha (St Philip the Apostle)
readings: Whoever has seen me has seen the Father
2026-11-14.verse: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you all this time, Philip, and you still do not know me? Whoever has seen me has seen the Father.

2026-11-16.title: Monday after the Sunday of the Message to Zechariah · Mar Mathai Shleeha (St Matthew the Apostle)
readings: Lead a life worthy of your calling
2026-11-16.verse: Go and learn what this means, ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice.’ For I have come to call not the righteous but sinners.

2026-11-17.title: Tuesday after the Sunday of the Message to Zechariah
2026-11-17.verse: And just then some people were carrying a paralyzed man lying on a bed. When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralytic, “Take heart, son; your sins are forgiven.”

2026-11-18.title: Wednesday after the Sunday of the Message to Zechariah
readings: The Lord be with your spirit
As a hen gathers her brood
2026-11-18.verse: Jerusalem, Jerusalem, the city that kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to it! How often have I desired to gather your children together as a hen gathers her brood under her wings, and you were not willing!

2026-11-19.title: Thursday after the Sunday of the Message to Zechariah
readings: Children and parents in the Lord
The greatest among you will be your servant
2026-11-19.verse: The greatest among you will be your servant.

2026-11-20.title: Friday after the Sunday of the Message to Zechariah
2026-11-20.verse: For, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord shall be saved.”

2026-11-21.title: The Entry of Mary, Mother of God, into the Temple
readings: Whoever does the will of my Father
2026-11-21.verse: For whoever does the will of my Father in heaven is my brother and sister and mother.

2026-11-23.title: Monday after the Sunday of the Annunciation · St Clement, Pope; St Felicity
readings: The hearts of the saints refreshed
A tree is known by its fruit
2026-11-23.verse: The good person out of the good treasure of the heart produces good, and the evil person out of evil treasure produces evil; for it is out of the abundance of the heart that the mouth speaks.

2026-11-24.title: Tuesday after the Sunday of the Annunciation
readings: The grace of God has appeared
2026-11-24.verse: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all,

2026-11-25.title: Wednesday after the Sunday of the Annunciation
readings: Christ is proclaimed, and in that I rejoice
Blessed are your eyes, for they see
2026-11-25.verse: But blessed are your eyes, for they see, and your ears, for they hear.

2026-11-26.title: Thursday after the Sunday of the Annunciation
readings: The cup of blessing and the bread we break
2026-11-26.verse: They were all amazed and kept saying to one another, “What kind of utterance is this? For with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and out they come!”

2026-11-27.title: Friday after the Sunday of the Annunciation
readings: Do not be weary in doing what is right
2026-11-27.verse: Therefore what God has joined together, let no one separate.

2026-11-28.title: Saturday after the Sunday of the Annunciation · St Catherine
readings: A father in Christ through the gospel
2026-11-28.verse: It is like a mustard seed, which, when sown upon the ground, is the smallest of all the seeds on earth; yet when it is sown it grows up and becomes the greatest of all shrubs, and puts forth large branches, so that the birds of the air can make nests in its shade.

2026-11-30.title: Monday after the Sunday of the Visitation · Mar Andrews Shleeha (St Andrew the Apostle)
readings: Until Christ is formed in you
2026-11-30.verse: He first found his brother Simon and said to him, “We have found the Messiah” (which is translated Anointed).
